WebUI thread start flow

pi-package-webui · branch feat/webui-compact-workspace (PR #38) · 2026-11-16 · plan: plans/archive/webui-thread-start-flow.md

Summary

The WebUI now starts threads like T3 Code. A pencil button in the sidebar opens a searchable New thread folder palette. Picking a folder opens an empty draft there, and no Pi process or server thread exists until the first prompt. On the draft's "Start a conversation" card, the Workspace value is a dropdown that switches the draft's folder. Visible text calls Pi conversations threads; code, routes and stored data are unchanged.

Flow

Pencil button→Palette: Current · No project · Pinned · Recent · Browse… · Branch worktree…→Empty draft with folder (no POST /api/tabs)→Workspace dropdown can change folder→First prompt creates one thread in that folder

Branch worktree is the exception: it still creates its thread immediately.

Decisions

DecisionChoice (user-approved)
Rename scopeVisible text only. IDs, CSS classes, /api/tabs, storage keys unchanged. New default title Thread N; stored Terminal N displays as Thread N without rewrite.
New thread buttonFolder palette first, reusing command-palette markup and styles.
Empty screenKeep the current card and tiles; the Workspace value becomes a searchable dropdown.
ProcessOpus implementation workers, Sol reviewers, at most two review rounds.

Screens

Residual risks

  • A blank draft's folder and the Recent order are lost on reload; drafts with text keep their folder (existing behavior).
  • During a pending first send, the card's folder button stays clickable; a choice is ignored with a warning.
  • A plain reload with several threads and no ?tab= can land without a selected thread. Boot selection code is unchanged by this branch; not investigated further.
  • 9 Chromium failures predate this work and remain.

Using it

Restart the WebUI preview and reload. Press the pencil button at the top of the thread sidebar, or run New thread from the command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K).
